Admissions (CCMT) and admissions are conducted on the basis of valid GATE score. For the admission in the Self Sponsored Category, candidates are shortlisted for written test on the basis of required qualification and the qualified candidates are called for personal interview for final selection. DOCTORAL The Institute provides facilities for research leading to the Degree of Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Engineering, Science, Humanities and Social Sciences in various disciplines. For the admission in the Ph.D. program, candidates are shortlisted for written test on the basis of required qualification (GATE/NET/SET qualified). The qualified candidates are called for personal interview. After qualifying, the candidates are provisionally admitted for Ph.D. in the Institute. Their registration for Ph.D. program at the Institute is confirmed only after successful completion of Pre-Registration viva-voce.
